Peneszlek Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Tanács utca 43, Hungary

Demolished. Established in 1891, this cemetery was demolished at an unknown time; locals say many of its gravestones sank into the ground due to a nearby sand mine — a similar fate to at least two other cemeteries elsewhere in this collection. The Lőrincz family appears repeatedly in Penészlek's small Jewish community across several generations and occupations, from merchants to livestock dealers to WWI servicemen. The village's 57 Jews in 1941 were deported first to the Nagykároly Ghetto, then to Mátészalka, and finally to Auschwitz; none remained by 1945.
